about: The Nov 1 2026 intake items that were left open: what each was tied to, or why it is recorded as unreachable. tied_to names a tool id and the rows of its file the item became; test/intake-rows.test.mjs proves each one is there. may_concern names recipes that share an item's subject without naming it as their source: it is not a tie. An unreachable item says what was tried and what closes it. Read again 2026-11-04: x.com, its embed and syndication hosts and blog.google were refused by this environment's network policy (403 at CONNECT), and web search returned nothing from the posts themselves.
